primaryDefect: S3 material records are static and are not tied to the native workbench's current shader inputs or the S2.1 common object protocol.
activeScope: One complete denim live-export vertical slice; loss-aware bridge of existing S3 material snapshots. Knit and leather live exporters remain next steps.
implementation: Replay the exact published R17.2 assembly at build time, append a read-only export sidecar in an isolated native copy, and use the unchanged S2.1 protocol for common objects. No native setters, render calls, or matrix updates in exporter.
acceptance: Removing the single sidecar insertion reproduces exact R17.2 HTML bytes
Same-frame protected state, geometry arrays, and shader source fingerprints unchanged by capture
Native input changes appear in GPU uniform readback after the native renderer settles
Old imported reports are never labelled as current live captures
Engineering estimates and unsupported units remain explicitly labelled through the common-protocol bridge
All invalid imports are rejected atomically; no silent repair or source write
Exact-source public HTTPS and self-contained file browser validation
No key or private runtime source included
next: Reuse tested read-only export contract for knit and leather; inspect getter side effects before integrating, then garment binding.
